work_items.title: Thread the near location hint through IMapyClient.SuggestAsync → Mapy preferNear param (backend)
acceptance_criteria: IMapyClient.SuggestAsync gains a nullable near hint parameter, e.g. Task<GeoResult<IReadOnlyList<MapySuggestResult>>> SuggestAsync(string query, (double Lat, double Lng)? near, string? serverKey, CancellationToken ct). Keep serverKey (the recent key-resolution fix). Update the XML doc for the new param (documenting that null omits the location bias). MapyClient is the ONLY production IMapyClient implementer (confirmed by grep) — no other impl/decorator exists.

MapyClient.SuggestAsync appends Mapy's location-preference parameter when near is non-null: the URL gains &preferNear={lng},{lat}&preferNearPrecision=5000 (verified vs live Mapy.com docs: preferNear is a POINT in {lon},{lat} order — LONGITUDE FIRST, identical to the existing RouteAsync start/end formatting; preferNearPrecision is a radius in metres). CRITICAL COORD-ORDER TRAP: the internal near tuple is (Lat, Lng) but Mapy's preferNear wants lng,lat — do NOT copy the tuple order blindly. Format BOTH coordinates with CultureInfo.InvariantCulture (the cs-CZ comma-decimal locale trap — mirror the existing ic = CultureInfo.InvariantCulture pattern in RouteAsync/ReverseGeocodeAsync). When near is null, omit preferNear + preferNearPrecision entirely (today's exact URL is unchanged).

GeoService.SuggestAsync forwards its existing near argument straight into mapyClient.SuggestAsync on BOTH paths: the Guid.Empty fleetless bypass (line ~31) AND the cached-factory path (line ~40). No other GeoService logic changes — the cache key already includes near (GeoCacheKey.Suggest(q, near)), so per-location caching is preserved. The key-missing short-circuit and GeoResult.Unavailable degradation are untouched.

Update all IMapyClient.SuggestAsync call sites and test doubles for the new signature: GeoService (2 call sites), the FakeMapyClient nested double in GeoServiceTests.cs (add a LastSuggestNear capture mirroring the existing LastServerKey capture), the CountingMapyClient nested double in GeoServiceTests.cs (signature only — no capture needed), and the MapyClientHandlerTests call sites (pass near: null where the existing tests do not exercise the hint). No signature change reaches any other file (grep-confirmed).

The suggest route/verb/policy and result shape are unchanged; the rate limiter and the SuggestEndpoint near-parsing (already lat,lng leniently parsed) are untouched. Quality gate: dotnet build -warnaserror AND dotnet test both green (user-local SDK C:\Users\alesm\AppData\Local\Microsoft\dotnet\dotnet.exe; Docker up for Testcontainers).
test_cases: SuggestAsync_NearSupplied_RequestUrlContainsPreferNear (extend MapyClientHandlerTests, mirror the existing SuggestAsync_Success_RequestUrlContainsTypeAndLangParams URL-capture test): call SuggestAsync with near=(50.08, 14.43) and assert the captured URL contains 'preferNear=14.43,50.08' (lng THEN lat — pins the coord order) and 'preferNearPrecision='. Also assert the coord segment is dot-decimal (InvariantCulture): the URL contains '14.43' and '50.08', never a comma-decimal like '14,43'.

SuggestAsync_NearNull_RequestUrlOmitsPreferNear (extend MapyClientHandlerTests): call SuggestAsync with near=null and assert the captured URL does NOT contain 'preferNear' (today's behaviour preserved).

Suggest_FleetlessBypass_ForwardsNearToClient (extend GeoServiceTests, add to the Guid.Empty bypass path): call geoService.SuggestAsync(Guid.Empty, "Praha", near:(50.08,14.43), ct) with a FakeMapyClient and assert fakeClient.LastSuggestNear == (50.08, 14.43) — proves the bypass path forwards near.

Suggest_CachedFactoryPath_ForwardsNearToClient (extend GeoServiceTests, add to the seeded-fleet cached path): seed a fleet, call geoService.SuggestAsync(fleetId, uniqueQuery, near:(50.08,14.43), ct) on a cache MISS and assert fakeClient.LastSuggestNear == (50.08, 14.43) — proves the cached-factory path forwards near.

Existing GeoService suggest tests (Suggest_NoFleetId_BypassesCacheAndUsage, Suggest_FleetHasServerKey_ResolvesAndPassesKeyToClient) keep passing with near:null threaded through — regression that null still omits the bias and does not break key resolution.
work_items.notes: BEST-EFFORT MAPY PARAM (verify-vs-live-docs, mirrors the MapyConstants tile-URL / CLAUDE.md UC-010 WI-09 precedent): preferNear + preferNearPrecision=5000 were verified against developer.mapy.com's search-area doc (preferNear = a point {lon},{lat}; preferNearPrecision = circle radius in metres). The developer implementing this MUST re-check the live https://api.mapy.com/v1/docs/ suggest reference before finalizing — the param NAME/precision is provisional, but the URL-capture test (present-when-supplied / absent-when-null + coord order + InvariantCulture) is what actually gates the WI, so a provisional-but-documented name is acceptable exactly like the tile URL. The dotnet-build -warnaserror gate is in AC#5; the verification.filter Taxi.Api.Tests.Geo covers BOTH MapyClientHandlerTests and GeoServiceTests (both in namespace Taxi.Api.Tests.Geo). No i18n / no route change / no rate-limiter change. This WI ships and verifies fully independently of the web lane (SuggestEndpoint already parses and forwards near).

work_items.title: Frontend: send near to /geo/suggest — pure best-location helper + wire map-center/config through useSuggest → DestinationSearch (web)
acceptance_criteria: getGeoSuggest gains an optional near arg: getGeoSuggest(q: string, near?: { lat: number; lng: number } | null): Promise<GeoSuggestResponse>. When near is provided it appends near={lat},{lng} to the query string (lat THEN lng — matches SuggestEndpoint's leniently-parsed lat,lng contract; the backend flips to Mapy's lng,lat internally, that is WI-1's job). Build it via URLSearchParams so numbers stringify dot-decimal (JS has no cs-CZ comma trap — mirror the getGeoReverse comment). When near is null/undefined, the query string is exactly today's (?q=...), so a no-location call is unchanged. Keep the DTO shapes untouched.

New PURE tested helper web/src/features/customer/order/suggestLocation.ts exporting a function that picks the best available suggest location in this precedence order: current map center → device GPS → fleet config center; returns null when none is available. Signature e.g. pickSuggestLocation(inputs: { mapCenter: LatLng | null; gpsLocation: LatLng | null; configCenter: LatLng | null }): LatLng | null (reuse the LatLng type from features/customer/shell/mapCamera). It ALSO rounds the chosen coordinate to a COARSE precision to prevent cache thrash on tiny map nudges — round to 2 decimals (~1.1 km, ample for ranking bias; deliberately COARSER than client.ts roundCoord's 4-decimal ~11 m). Rounding lives INSIDE this helper so the granularity is pinned by a unit test. NO React, no I/O, no DI — a pure module like orderCamera.ts / mapCamera.ts.

useSuggest accepts the near location and threads it into both the query and the query key: useSuggest(query: string, near?: LatLng | null). The queryFn calls getGeoSuggest(debounced, near) and the queryKey becomes ['geo','suggest', debounced, near] so a change in the (already-coarse-rounded) near re-queries and caches per location (rules/web-performance.md#query-keys — patch the exact hierarchical key, never a bare invalidate). Debounce window, MIN_SUGGEST_CHARS floor, staleTime, and the anonymous-by-slug behaviour are unchanged. Because near is coarse-rounded upstream in suggestLocation, tiny map nudges keep the same key (no thrash).

DestinationSearch gains a near prop (near?: LatLng | null) and passes it to useSuggest(query, near). The component stays presentational (no location decision inside it — that lives in suggestLocation.ts / MapOrderPage). No other DestinationSearch behaviour, ARIA, or markup changes.

MapOrderPage supplies the best location to DestinationSearch: it already owns pendingCenter (the live settled map center from CustomerMapShell.onCenterChange) and can read the fleet config center via useGeoConfig ({ mapCenterLat, mapCenterLng }). Compute near = pickSuggestLocation({ mapCenter: pendingCenter, gpsLocation: null, configCenter: <from useGeoConfig or null while loading> }) and pass it to <DestinationSearch near={near} ... />. GPS is a DESIGNED-IN helper tier but is supplied as null here (no geolocation hook exists in the customer shell yet — deliberately out of scope; the helper accepts it so a future GPS wire is a one-line change). Do NOT add useMemo/useCallback unless a measured re-render problem is recorded (rules/web-performance.md#memoization-policy) — pickSuggestLocation is cheap and coarse-rounded so the query key is stable across renders anyway.

No new user-facing string is added (confirmed) — no cs-CZ.json / en-US.json / other locale change, no i18n parity impact. The suggest result shape, DestinationSearch ARIA combobox, and every other customer-order behaviour are unchanged. Quality gate (AC#5, web lane, NO e2e — there is no user-flow DOM change): npm run --prefix web tsc + npm run --prefix web lint (0 warnings) + npm run --prefix web test + npm run --prefix web build + npm run --prefix web size all green.
test_cases: suggestLocation.test.ts — pickSuggestLocation prefers mapCenter over GPS over configCenter: given all three, returns the (rounded) mapCenter; given no mapCenter but GPS, returns GPS; given only configCenter, returns configCenter; given none, returns null.

suggestLocation.test.ts — coarse rounding is pinned: an input like { lat: 50.087654, lng: 14.431234 } returns { lat: 50.09, lng: 14.43 } (2 decimals); two inputs within ~1 km of each other that round to the same coordinate return an EQUAL value (deep-equal) so the query key is stable (no thrash), while a >~1.1 km move rounds to a different value.

client.test.ts — getGeoSuggest sends near: mock apiRequest / capture the URL; getGeoSuggest('Kouřimská', { lat: 50.09, lng: 14.43 }) requests a URL containing 'q=Kou' AND 'near=50.09%2C14.43' (or near=50.09,14.43) — lat,lng order, dot-decimal. getGeoSuggest('Kouřimská') (no near) requests a URL with NO 'near=' param (today's behaviour).

useSuggest.test.ts — the existing debounce/min-chars/logged-out tests are updated for the new signature: getGeoSuggest is now called with (query, near) — e.g. toHaveBeenCalledWith('Hlavní', <near-or-undefined>). Add a re-query test: rendering useSuggest('Hlavní', nearA) then rerendering with a DIFFERENT coarse near (nearB) fires a second getGeoSuggest call with nearB (the query key changed); rerendering with an equal-rounded near does NOT add a call.

DestinationSearch.test.tsx — passing a near prop threads it into the suggest call (mock @/shared/api/client, assert getGeoSuggest received the near); the existing combobox ARIA / keyboard / empty-state tests keep passing unchanged; the standard vitest-axe assertion still passes (no new interactive element).

MapOrderPage.test.tsx — the page wires the best location: with a mocked useGeoConfig (config center) and a simulated onCenterChange (map center) it passes a non-null near down to DestinationSearch (assert via the mocked useSuggest/getGeoSuggest or a DestinationSearch spy); before any center is known it falls back to the config center; existing MapOrderPage behaviours (pickup reverse-geocode, price sheet gating, camera) keep passing.
work_items.notes: depends_on WI-1 for the END-TO-END contract only (the backend must honour near for AC#1 ranking to actually work); the frontend code is otherwise independently testable with a mocked client, so it can be developed in parallel and only the e2e-less quality gate needs both lanes. All network is mocked (rules/web-testing.md#network-mocking) — no live suggest. TEST-ORDERING ladder: pure suggestLocation.ts first, then client.ts, then useSuggest hook, then DestinationSearch + MapOrderPage component/render, then a11y (rules/web-testing.md#test-ordering). COARSE ROUNDING RATIONALE: client.ts roundCoord is 4 decimals (~11 m) which would re-query on every small nudge — the spec explicitly says round to avoid cache thrash, so suggestLocation rounds to 2 decimals (~1.1 km) and useSuggest keys on that. GPS TIER: supplied as null by MapOrderPage today (no geolocation hook in the customer shell) — the helper accepts it so the reviewer should NOT flag a missing GPS wire; it is a deliberate, documented placeholder. NO i18n change (no new string). AC#5 web gate has NO e2e — no user-flow DOM change (rules/web-testing.md#e2e-conventions: e2e covers the 3 critical flows only, and this changes ranking, not the flow).
